text_sanskrit: अस्माकं तु विशिष्टा ये तान्निबोध द्विजोत्तम । नायका मम सैन्यस्य संज्ञार्थं तान्ब्रवीमि ते ॥ १-७ ॥
itrans: asmAkaM tu vishiShTA ye tAnnibodha dvijottama . nAyakA mama sainyasya sa.nj~nArthaM tAnbravImi te .. 1-7 ..
translation: Now on our side also (thou mayest) know those who are the best among the leaders of our army. I name them for your special notice.
